subject: Weekly staff highlight: wins, blockers, and decision lanes for QBR
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: exec-staff@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly staff highlight: wins, blockers, and decision lanes for QBR

Team —

Quick weekly readout ahead of Wednesday's QBR prep slot. Short bullets followed by specific asks so we can lock decisions before the deck goes to the execs.

Wins:
- Serving runtime: 12% latency improvement on 8k token tails after microkernel patch; validated across internal perf harness.
- Dedicated pilot: Early customers for batch-heavy workflows onboarded; first week throughput within 95th percentile of our SLA.
- Observability: Per-route token breakdown landed — finance sign-off for retention scope done.

Risks & current mitigations:
- Capacity headroom in eu-west-1 is tighter than forecasted (see attached metrics). Mitigation: temporary routing to eu-central for non-guaranteed workload; still exposes some tail SLO risk.
- Quality regressions observed for quantized 4-bit variant on long-context LMs (low-frequency hallucination spike). Mitigation: temporary pin to fp16 for paid routes and scheduled regression eval this week.

Asks / decision lanes (please reply inline with Approve/Reject/Ask for detail):
1) Dedicated pilot: approve $45k incremental monthly reserve to expand pilot by 30% (proposal in QBR_ops_brief.pdf §2). Need decision by EOD Wed so procurement can issue amendment.
2) SLO window change: allow 200ms soft-tail bump for batch-optimized endpoints during peak (proposal attached). Vote yes/no; we will include approved language in QBR.
3) QBR slot: request 10 minutes for ops to present heatmap + two concrete asks above. Confirm whether we get the slot (deck attached).

Attachments: QBR_ops_brief.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB), QBR_metrics.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/1QBR_ops_summary_2028

Short ask: please reply with explicit Approve/Reject for items 1–2 and whether the 10-minute slot is confirmed.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly staff highlight: wins, blockers, and decision lanes for QBR

Priya — thanks for the concise layout. Quick questions before I say yes on the pilot spend:
- Can you confirm the expected cost per QPS for the expanded reserve vs current? The deck shows aggregated $45k but not the per-unit delta. If you can drop a one-line addendum (or point me to the specific tab in QBR_metrics.xlsx) I can greenlight this by lunch.

Also, I support the 10-minute slot — ops heatmap is useful.

On SLO bump: I'd like to see a short rollback plan if we observe SLA violations post-change (one slide). Can your team add that to the deck?

Thanks,
Laura
Chief of Staff

Priya / Laura — I’m OK to support the Dedicated pilot expansion. Approve $45k monthly on a time-limited basis (90 days) pending the follow-up cost per QPS from Priya.

Also agree we should include a rollback slide for the SLO change. Ops, please include the trigger thresholds and owner for rollback.

Vivek
